title: Politics and Language | Noam Chomsky | Talks at Google
summary: Noam Chomsky gives a Talks at Google lecture covering his work on politics and language. It touches on his linguistic theory, including universal grammar, alongside his political criticism.
why: HN commenters point to it as an easy-to-grasp introduction to Chomsky's ideas on universal grammar and the language faculty.

quote.text: a pretty good, easy to grasp intro to his ideas on universal grammar and the language faculty
